evidence_quotes.quote: SiS GO Hydro tube of 20 x 4.2 g effervescent tablets (84 g net): per tablet in 500 ml water delivers 345 mg sodium, 65 mg potassium, 102 mg calcium, 8.1 mg magnesium, 269 mg chloride.
Approx. 9 kcal per tablet, 0.8 g carbohydrates (0.1 g sugar), sweetened with sucralose and sorbitol.
Informed Sport batch-tested; vegan and gluten-free.

adversarial_checks: Verified 4.2 g x 20 = 84 g net weight (0.0% deviation) and Na+K active: (345 + 65)/1000 = 0.41 g.
Verified purity math: 0.41 / 4.2 * 100 = 9.76% mineral purity; total pure Na+K = 8.20 g.
Verified 9 kcal (<20 kcal threshold) and documented sucralose/sorbitol 4-tab daily guidance.
Confirmed zero legacy blocklist overlap and SM-05 factual compliance.
